newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Alfa started as buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Alfa started as buy.

text.p: -- ABN-AMRO Hoare Govett said it started coverage of Mexican conglomerate Grupo Industrial Alfa SA with a buy rating.

-- Analyst Alejandro Delgado said Mexico's largest conglomerate is heavily weighted in the sectors set to benefit from a rapid recovery in the Mexican economy. "Growth in construction and packaging will increase demand for Alfa's steel and plastic products, while its auto parts division exports 90 percent of its production," Delgado said.
-- The food division will begin contributing to earnings now that it is focusing on margins rather than market share and the telecommunications venture will start operating in early 1997.
-- Heavy capital expenditure programs will boost output in steel and petrochemicals.
-- Alfa is also undervalued, the report said.
-- Alfa was unchanged in early trade on the Mexican bourse.
